findings.question: q-chemistry-nuclear-chemistry-0011
findings.quote: A lighter shield reduces gamma intensity more than a denser one.
findings.problem: The comparison does not hold shield thickness fixed. A sufficiently thick concrete shield can reduce the same gamma beam more than a thin lead sheet, even though concrete is less dense. Thus this intended wrong choice can also be true alongside the key; density alone does not determine which shield reduces intensity more.
findings.fix: Specify the same gamma radiation and equal shield thicknesses when comparing materials, and make the paper-versus-lead comparison use those same conditions.
